children: Russia's Lukoil, the country's second-largest oil producer, said on Friday that its Russian hydrocarbon production fell 5.2% on the year in the second half to 1.722 million barrels of oil equivalent per day.
The company also said its oil processing volumes at its refineries in Russia declined to 18.8 million metric tons in the first half of this year from 20.7 million tons in the same period last year.
